verdict.rationale: Notte documents a hosted, Bearer-authenticated REST API with an agent-start endpoint for running web AI agents on natural-language tasks in cloud browser sessions, so the agent never manages a browser itself (notte-docs-37, notte-docs-17, notte-gh-1, notte-docs-24). Serverless functions can also be invoked as API endpoints (notte-docs-2, notte-docs-26). However, nothing in the pack shows how results are returned, whether by a status-polling endpoint or a webhook callback, and no public OpenAPI spec was found. Missing for 10: documented result polling/status endpoint, webhook delivery of results, published OpenAPI spec, independent hands-on corroboration of the async task API.
